metadata.name: File Drop Physics
metadata.description: A file upload card where dropped files fall onto a pile with a bouncy spring and a random tilt. Drag to reorder, remove to fly off; each file shows a progress ring, a total progress bar, and an error state with retry.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
